Players Committee card image of [[Death Trooper]] (original printing), game text: “While you have no other trooper here (except death troopers), adds one battle destiny at same site as Krennic, Tarkin or Thrawn. May place this character in Used Pile to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting your leader here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/deathtrooper.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
